name: Pressure Cooker
source:
Two women trapped in an elevator.
It's been who-knows-how-many hours.
Tensions are high.
They are sweaty and on edge.
Any spark will put them at each other's throats.

[From [url=https://perpetuareality.itch.io/pressure-cooker]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两名女子被困电梯内。
谁知道已经过了多少个小时了。
紧张局势很高。
他们满头大汗，紧张不安。
任何火花都会让他们互相掐架。

[来自[url=https://perpetuareality.itch.io/pressure-cooker]itch.io[/url]]
